title: DreamMusicForge Principle Kernel
description: Output of the Principle Engine (pipeline stage 1). The root data contract every downstream engine (Human Experience, Story Architecture, Emotional Architecture, ...) traces back to.

kernel_statement.description: One sentence, timeless-truth framing of what this principle asserts about human experience. Describes the terrain the work explores -- never a mandate for what the viewer must conclude.

polarity.description: The tension this principle sits against; feeds the Story/Emotional Architecture engines' conflict stage.

human_truths.description: Candidate authentic-human-experience framings of the principle (Human Experience Engine input). Each must answer 'what changes?'

transformation_goal_seed.description: Stated as a probability, e.g. 'may help the audience feel X is possible' -- never as a guarantee of viewer outcome.

non_goals.description: Must include the required ethics constraint below; may include others.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.

truth_status.description: Confidence in the kernel as a whole, per this repo's truth-status convention.
